resource_baseline.role: Resource identity baseline only. It is not asserted as the runtime HEAD.

current_parent_reported_candidate.role: Root supplied successor with linked coverage/support corrections; the outer frozen policy must independently bind its actual full tree and derive both JSON documents.

interface.signature: run(source, evidence, python, image, compiler, child_script, *, source_sha256, bridge_sha256, child_sha256) -> dict
interface.fails_with: Writes package-report.json as HOLD when the installation root was created, then raises RuntimeError. Missing or unclosed child outputs remain missing; they are never synthesized.
interface.source_head: Reads and rechecks actual detached .git/HEAD before/after. No guessed current tree.

pipeline: Copy all actual packaging inputs into a create-only source directory.
Own 120-second setup.py sdist process; fully read gzip CRC, tar members and required input identities.
Own 120-second no-index/no-build-isolation/no-deps pip wheel from the actual sdist; fully read ZIP CRC and member identities.
Own 120-second no-index/no-deps/no-compile pip --target installation from the actual wheel.
Inspect every installed regular file and exact 169 Python / 96 source-resource namespaces.
Copy this run's already freshly compiled actual image, bind actual source/image/compiler SHA in a development manifest.
Own a distinct five-second -I -S -B empty-PATH consumer for all nine exact controls.
Recheck the original source inputs, actual source HEAD, immutable image/compiler/controls, built archives and restored installed bytes/modes.

packaging_tools.pip: Actual installed version recorded; no network installation performed.

budgets.note: Per-process ceilings do not extend the unchanged outer deadline. Original 43/108 remains a separate child under its original five-second ceiling.

derived_process_note: <label>.step.json is a derived seventh summary, not a seventh original. Actual disk receipt is hashed before JSON parsing; returned run_owned fields are independently reconciled with raw receipt and request.
closed_read_boundary: Returned cleanup must show complete, ECHILD, leader_reaped, no remaining children, no errors and no cleanup deadline overrun before helper reads any step output. Otherwise it records the returned metadata plus fixed deferred paths and does not read source/installed after-state. Root's external guardian/finalizer may collect those originals only after its own bound cleanup.
natural_process_boundary: A successful process additionally requires original request argv/cwd/env/paths/limits/owner SHA, raw receipt SHA, exit0, no timeout, no owner_error, no interruptions, no overflow and no kill events; actual started/exit-observed/reaped events must all be present.
compiler_manifest_boundary: The loader requires valid compiler SHA syntax; it does not independently compare a second syntactically valid compiler hash. The malformed syntax control is explicitly scoped. The parent must bind actual compiler bytes to its fresh B0/B1/B2 build, image and package manifest.
restoration_boundary: Warm mutation/missing-source controls intentionally change installed inode/timestamps. Final success requires all installed bytes and modes restored; no claim is made that those test-mutated identities never changed. Immutable native image and manifest identities remain stable.
forbidden_paths: During formatting, host JSON layout functions are blocked and actual entry completions counted. Child imports no tools/tests/setuptools/pip/wheel; all loaded hepta modules originate under the explicit installed root.
acceptance_not_claimed: actual installation or test pass before execution

parent_integration_cross_read.result: Actual call signature was read and matches this interface. Parent controller independently accepts raw artifacts; this document is not execution evidence.
